text: Turn a natural-language idea into a working app in minutes without coding
quote: Turn ideas into apps in minutes — no coding needed

text: Describe a project and Replit writes and evolves production-ready code for it
quote: Describe and publish your project. Replit writes production-ready code, evolves it, and stays out of your way.

text: Built-in auth, database, hosting, and monitoring services with zero setup
quote: Built-in services with zero setup- Authentication, Database, Hosting, and Monitoring, enabling you to build fully scalable apps easily and securely from day one.

text: Add AI features and 100+ third-party integrations like OpenAI and Stripe in minutes
quote: Enhance your apps with AI and 100+ integrations. Connect to OpenAI, Stripe, Google Workspace, and more in minutes.

text: Enterprise security controls including SSO/SAML, SOC 2 compliance, and admin controls
quote: Security controls: SSO/SAML, SOC 2, and admin controls. Screening and secure services keep apps safe.

text: Visual design space to explore and tweak designs, then apply them to the app
quote: Introducing a new space that allows you to explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app.

text: Free Mode lets you explore ideas and start building without immediate cost
quote: Free Mode: Explore ideas, ask questions, start building, and keep everyday work moving.

text: Publishing creates a stable production deployment running at its own URL
quote: Publishing creates a **production deployment**: a stable, shareable version of your app that runs at its own URL.

text: Publish an app as public so anyone with the link can access it
quote: **Public** makes the app available to anyone with the link.

text: Add a database so app data persists across sessions
quote: Add a database so everything persists.

text: Move a published app from its default subdomain to a custom domain
quote: Move Velocity from velocity.replit.app to velocityrentals.com.

text: Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources via MCP
quote: Replit Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

text: Auth and database services are provisioned by Agent with no separate dashboard signup or OAuth key copying
quote: Both are provisioned by Agent — no separate dashboard signup, no copy-pasting of OAuth keys.

text: Invite teammates to collaborate on the same project with Agent, each starting their own threads
quote: Invite teammates to your project and build together — each person can start new threads with Agent while working on the same project.

text: Turn a selected design template frame into a functional website via Agent, preview it, and publish a live URL
quote: Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.

text: Extend Replit by connecting tools and adding reusable Skills through MCP
quote: Connect your tools, add reusable Skills, and extend Replit with MCP.

text: Publishing includes monitoring tools for app status and web analytics
quote: Publishing includes tools to monitor your published app status and view web analytics.

text: Save app data to a database so it doesn't disappear on refresh
quote: Save Velocity's data to a database so cars, availability, and reservations don't disappear on refresh.

text: Simplified publishing process to share an app with the world
quote: Publishing lets you share your Replit App with the world using a simplified process.

text: Curated list of pre-built MCP servers for popular services like Stripe, Linear, Notion, and Sentry
quote: Replit ships with a curated list of MCP servers for popular services like Stripe, Linear, Notion, Sentry, and more.

text: Ask Replit to use a connected service's context to answer questions or complete tasks in the same conversation
quote: Connect a service, then ask Replit to find relevant context, answer a question, or help complete a task in the same conversation.

text: Build a selected template into a working website that preserves visual design while making navigation and contact actions functional
quote: Build this selected template as a functional website. Preserve its visual design and make its navigation and contact actions work.

text: Password-protect a published app requiring visitors to enter a shared password
quote: Password protected requires visitors to enter a shared password.

text: Agent Modes let you choose the balance of included allowance, credits, and capability before sending a request
quote: Agent Modes let you choose the balance between included allowance, credits, and capability before you send a request.

text: Agent automatically provisions separate Development and Production environments
quote: Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.

text: Integrations bring information from tools you already use into Replit
quote: Integrations bring information from the tools you already use into Replit.

text: Start building on the web, in a Desktop App, or in a Mobile App
quote: Start on the web, in the Desktop App, or in the Mobile App.

text: Start a project with a conversation to ask questions, research ideas, and document a plan
quote: Start with a conversation. Ask questions, research ideas, and document your plan.

text: Iterate on layouts, components, and interface experiences to create interfaces and content
quote: Create beautiful interfaces and content. Iterate on layouts, components, and experiences.

text: Restrict published app access to invite-only groups or individuals
quote: Public makes the app available to anyone with the link... Invite only limits access to the people or groups you select.

text: Add an MCP server not in the pre-listed catalog by providing its URL
quote: If the server you want isn't in the pre-listed catalog, add it by URL.
